title: On scalar and electromagnetic perturbations of the root--Kerr object
summary: We study scalar and electromagnetic perturbations of the root--Kerr object. Its source-free exterior carries the electromagnetic field obtained in the vanishing-mass limit of the Kerr--Newman black hole, while its physical source is a rotating disk with an essential distributional rim contribution. For a massless charged scalar, the minimally coupled Klein--Gordon equation separates into a confluent-Heun (CHE) radial equation with a direct coupling between the scalar and background charges.
